abstentions.query: MATCH (n) WHERE (n:Analytic OR n:Campaign OR n:DataComponent OR n:DetectionStrategy OR n:Group OR n:Matrix OR n:Mitigation OR n:Software OR n:SubTechnique OR n:Tactic OR n:Technique) AND any(term IN $names WHERE toLower(n.name) CONTAINS term) WITH collect(n) AS cand WITH cand, [x IN cand WHERE any(t IN $names WHERE toLower(x.name) = t)] AS exact UNWIND (CASE WHEN size(exact) > 0 THEN exact ELSE cand END) AS n OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r]-(m) WITH n, CASE WHEN m IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE type(r) END AS rel, CASE WHEN m IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE startNode(r) = n END AS outgoing, CASE WHEN m IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE head(labels(m)) END AS neighbour_label, count(m) AS cnt WITH n, collect(CASE WHEN rel IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE {rel: rel, outgoing: outgoing, label: neighbour_label, count: cnt} END) AS raw WITH n, [f IN raw WHERE f IS NOT NULL] AS facets RETURN coalesce(n.attack_id, n.id) AS id, n.name AS name, n.properties_json AS properties_json, facets AS facets LIMIT 1000
